_meta.title: Acknowledgements Formats — output spec + build data
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable form of 00_Copyright_Acks_Formatting_Rules.md (§1–5 output formats, §6 build regexes/authority rules, §7 oEmbed, §8 ACK-TODO contract). AcksBuilder.js reads THIS file; no ack format lives in code. Templates use {placeholders} filled by the builder.
_meta.extension_rule: New entry type, new source provider, new standing text, new marker type = a data edit HERE, never a code change.
_meta.precedence: This file mirrors 00_Copyright_Acks_Formatting_Rules.md, which beats every older reference (v1 video format, Shutterstock long form, acksTemplate retirement claim are all superseded).
_meta.policy: The acknowledgements block is generated for EVERY module — always, no conditional logic. Placement: bottom of the very first page (-00 overview, or the only page of a single-file module), as div.acks AFTER (outside) the #footer div. Never on the last page.

container.wrapper_open: Acknowledgements
container.ai_variant_rule: Use the AI variant container when the module contains ANY AI-generated item (source classified 'ai').
container.wrapper_note: row > col-md-8 wrapper matches current corpus practice (e.g. OSAH401_0.0.html).

lesson_groups.group_label_note: The lesson-naming comment is part of the acks output spec (§1) — one of the sanctioned comment uses. Lesson ids use the page's decimal form, e.g. 'Lesson 1.0'.

journal.heading: Journal
journal.status: Supported in the output structure; AUTOMATIC grouping of journal items is deferred until the marking convention is confirmed with CS (Phase-1 scope). No journal group is auto-emitted.

standing_items.opening_disclaimer: Every effort has been made to acknowledge and contact copyright holders. Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu apologises for any omissions and welcomes more accurate information.
standing_items.ai_usage_statement: Parts of this resource were created with assistance from AI tools. For more information on the extent and nature of this AI usage, please contact Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu.
standing_items.ai_usage_rule: Emit directly underneath the opening disclaimer when the module contains AI-assisted content (any item classified 'ai').
standing_items.catch_all: All other images © Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu, Wellington, New Zealand.
standing_items.catch_all_note: When Te Kura-produced video/audio is also present the human form expands ('All other images and audio …'); the converter cannot reliably know that, so it emits the base line — a developer adjusts if needed.

No part of this publication may be reproduced or transmitted in any form or by any means without the written permission of Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu.
standing_items.year_rule: The year is NEVER hard-coded — the empty renders it.

kb_template_form.rule: KB constraints 45 + 90; CL-0090 is a LOCKED admin decision (example: WJFUN105_0.0). The acknowledgements wrapper is `acks acksTemplate` on EVERY module (plus `acksAI` where the module has AI media — the AI variant), and the template classes GENERATE the apology, the Copyright © <span class=currentYear> line and the AI statement — typing them as well produces a visible double-up on the published page. Only the catch-all line (All other images © …) is typed, as an unlabelled acksLesson div after the media entries. The standard container class comes from acks_class_standard here (the legacy `acks` in container.acks_class_standard is used in the OFF state), and the template_variant_omit list applies ALWAYS (omit_always), not only on the AI variant. Much of the gold uses the older convention (bare `acks` with the boilerplate typed, often on the last page, a placement constraint 33 rejects); the KB outranks the gold here because the gold predates the rule — a NAMED KB-over-gold override, judged per Subject_Global_Parameters._meta.gold_override_policy (b). Env toggle ACKSTEMPLATE_OFF turns off both the class and the always-omit; ACKSBOILER_OFF turns off the omit list alone.

template_variant_omit.rule: When the block uses the TEMPLATE container class (the AI variant 'acks acksTemplate acksAI'), the site's own stylesheet/template INJECTS the standing boilerplate — so emitting the three paragraphs too makes them appear TWICE on the published page (as in SCCH302). The gold's template-class blocks mostly omit them, while its plain 'acks' blocks keep them. The listed standing items are therefore OMITTED when (and only when) the template/AI container class is emitted; the catch_all line is KEPT (most template-class golds carry it); an opening group left EMPTY by the omission (no unverified-iStock note to carry) is dropped whole — the gold form shows no empty acksLesson div. The few gold triple-class blocks that keep the paragraphs (ENGJ403/BLL275/SSOG105) are the minority form. Env ACKSBOILER_OFF emits all three paragraphs regardless of class.

hyperlink_rule.anchor_text: the full URL itself — never descriptive text
hyperlink_rule.note: Comma + space precedes the link; the full stop sits OUTSIDE . iStock/Getty entries are plain text only.

type_prefix_map._fallback_rule: Unknown item type → Title Case the writer's own word as the prefix AND record a red-flag note in the summary (never silently absorb).

source_classification.rule: Classify each media item by first matching the URL domain, then the Source column keywords, then type keywords. First hit wins.
source_classification.tekura_rule: Items classified 'tekura' are covered by the standing catch-all line — no individual entry is emitted.
source_classification.non_media_skip: Item types in skip_types are lesson links, not acknowledgeable media — skip the entry, record a summary note (scope rule §1: external links used in lessons do not receive acknowledgements).

istock_slug_title.rule: The iStock URL slug IS the official asset title in kebab-case (98% verified on 1,388 pairs): split the slug on '-', Title Case each word, then apply special_tokens casing. Only a bare ID with no URL needs manual sourcing → ACK-TODO[istock-name].
istock_slug_title.special_tokens_note: Only unambiguous abbreviations belong here — 'it'/'id' are left out because they are ordinary words in titles ('It features…').
istock_slug_title.casing_note: Minor punctuation/case differences from the provider's exact casing are acceptable per the verified rule — human-written acks vary too.

istock_acks_file._note:
The OPTIONAL verified iStock acknowledgements file (CL-0002, part of the input contract). A file of iStock acknowledgements can be uploaded alongside the WT + Media List (or sit in the module folder for a batch run): one fully-formed ack per line, e.g.

Photo: Friends dancing in the street, iStock 1422643105, Getty Images. Used with permission.

, sourced from the iStock API via Getty — so its titles are DEFINITELY correct and OUTRANK the slug-derived title (title_authority for iStock becomes: API file > URL slug > ACK-TODO). The engine parses each line into id → {title, line} (line_pattern below: title = everything between the first ': ' and the LAST ', iStock ,' — titles may themselves contain commas); when #istockEntry knows the asset id and the map carries it, the VERIFIED title fills the normal entry template ({TypePrefix}/{Adapted} still composed per the item), which for a photo reproduces the file's own line exactly. Ids not in the file fall back to the slug rule / ACK-TODO unchanged. Env ISTOCKACKS_OFF (or enabled:false) ignores the file entirely.

detect._note: CONTENT-FIRST recognition. Matching on the file NAME alone would break as soon as the module code joins the filename (_istock-acks-OSAI501.txt / _OSAI501-istock-acks.txt) and cannot cope with the variants in circulation, so the file is recognised by WHAT IT CONTAINS: any .txt whose lines are iStock acknowledgements (line_pattern above) and effectively nothing else. The filename is a SECONDARY safeguard only — 'istock' and/or 'acks' anywhere in it raises confidence and breaks ties between two qualifying files, but never gates acceptance. This is safe on the corpus: the other .txt files beside the module .docx inputs are '*_parsed.txt' WT dumps, none of which contain a matching line; the generator's own {CODE}_interactives.txt hand-off is excluded by the same content test. Env ISTOCKDETECT_OFF uses the filename-only rule (filename_pattern).
detect.share_note: min_share_of_nonempty guards the 'and nothing else' half of the rule: a .txt that merely MENTIONS iStock in prose (a writer's note, a media list dump) fails it. min_matching_lines stops a one-line fragment qualifying. A file passing both is the acks file whatever it is called.

family_credit_flags._doc: Flagged placeholders for a missing family credit (KB 05C 'Sourcing the acknowledgement entries': where a credit is unavailable, raise a VISIBLE red flag for the developer to complete — not a hidden HTML comment). A family whose Writers Template never carries its credit line: every EMPTY per-lesson acks group (no entry built for it) gets a visible red Designer/Developer To Do after its constraint-73 lesson label, and the catch-all line takes the family's own form. Keyed by code prefix, one row per family. The XOTP reader books: the human builds credit the story ('Story: <title> by Anne Russell and Rosemary Emery, © Off The Page. Used with permission.') and close with 'All illustrations © Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu…'; the WT only links the reader, so the credit cannot be derived. Env XOTPACKS_OFF turns the flags and the family catch-all off.

rows.empty_group_flag: credit needed for this lesson's reader book — add the story's credit line in the family form: "Story: <title> by <author(s)>, © <publisher>. Used with permission." (the Writers Template links the book but gives no credit).
rows.catch_all: All illustrations © Te Aho o Te Kura Pounamu, Wellington, New Zealand.

istock_unverified._note:
SOURCING HONESTY for iStock TITLES. Without a verified acks file every iStock title is DERIVED from the URL slug (the istock_slug_title rule, highly accurate but not confirmed) and the finished line reads exactly like a verified one, so the designer cannot tell which titles were checked against the iStock API and which were inferred. So an unverified iStock acknowledgement carries a VISIBLE marker, and the page carries one red designer note explaining why. This is the ACK-TODO contract's third state — the line is COMPLETE (no bracketed slot) but UNCONFIRMED — so it deliberately does NOT take the ackTodo class: it stays a plain

exactly like the human's, gaining only the marker character. That keeps its class and structure unchanged while still showing the marker on the page. Ids the file DOES cover are untouched; entries already carrying a visible ❗ (istock-name / asset-id ACK-TODOs) are left alone — they are flagged already. Env ISTOCKUNVERIFIED_OFF.
istock_unverified.note_form: Designer/Developer To Do: {text}
istock_unverified.note_no_file: No iStock acknowledgements file (*istock-acks*.txt) was supplied with this module, so the {count} iStock title{plural} below could not be verified against the iStock API and {were} derived from the image URL. Each unverified line is marked ❗. Please supply the verified acknowledgements file, or confirm each title before publishing.
istock_unverified.note_partial: The supplied iStock acknowledgements file did not cover {count} of the iStock asset{plural} used in this module, so {those} title{plural} were derived from the image URL rather than verified against the iStock API. Each unverified line is marked ❗. Unverified asset id{plural}: {ids}.
istock_unverified.note_position: top of the acknowledgements block, inside the opening-disclaimer group — the designer reads it in context, immediately above the ❗ lines it refers to. Carries class cv2-note, like every other converter note.

title_authority.stock: Official asset name only — writer descriptions are NOT acceptable for stock assets (istock/other_stock/pixabay). Derive from the URL slug, or emit ACK-TODO[istock-name].
title_authority.youtube: oEmbed title/author verbatim (including any '| Site' suffix), or ACK-TODO[video-meta].
title_authority.website: The writer's description is the normal title source for non-stock web media — use it as {Title}.

oembed.retrieved_date_rule: Stamped by the program at fetch time — the converter's own run date.
oembed.failure_rule: Empty body or HTTP error → ACK-TODO[video-meta] with reason 'unavailable' | 'offline' | 'error'. Never fabricate fields. A fetch failure doubles as a dead-link signal worth surfacing.
oembed.cors_note: The endpoint echoes Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so in-browser fetch works.

ack_todo.policy: Every marker has a VISIBLE component. The HTML comment is a machine-readable supplement only — never the sole signal, because an HTML comment is easily missed.
ack_todo.flag_unknown_type_note: When an item's type is NOT in type_prefix_map, #typePrefix falls back to Title-casing the writer's own word ('jpg'→'Jpg', 'text'→'Text') and would log a SUMMARY note only — so the acks line would carry NO visible ❗, unlike the video-meta line beside it which DOES carry one. A line that cannot be confidently formatted 'due to not enough information' must carry the SAME ❗ as the other incomplete copyright lines. With this on, an unknown-type entry that built a plain line is re-emitted as a visible ❗ ackTodo (type 'unknown-type'), keeping its content but flagging it for CS; an entry that is ALREADY a TODO (e.g. asset-id) is untouched (it already shows ❗), and skip/tekura items are unaffected (they never produce a line). DATA-driven cure: ADD a recurring type (jpg, pdf, text, mp3, webpage, doc …) to type_prefix_map (a data edit) and the flag disappears for it. Env ACKUNKNOWN_OFF uses the silent summary-only fallback. The ❗ ackTodo lines are draft lines for CS to resolve; the human build ships fully-resolved acks with no counterpart for them.
ack_todo.visible_form_designer: ❗ Confirm any media added during design for this lesson is acknowledged, then delete this line.

istock-name.when: iStock ID known, no URL to derive the title from, title not in writer docs

asset-id.when: title known, no ID/URL in writer docs

licence.when: CC item whose licence name is not in writer docs

unknown-type.when: item type not in type_prefix_map — the built line cannot be confidently formatted; surfaced with the SAME ❗ as the other incomplete lines instead of a silent summary note

ack_todo.security: ACK-TODO comments carry only sourcing metadata — NEVER answer content (converter-wide rule).
ack_todo.build_gate: The conversion summary reports the per-module ACK-TODO count; acks are complete only at zero.
